steps.name: fetch_leave_records
steps.description: Read all employee leave records from local mock storage (simulates Google Sheets).

steps.name: validate_normalize_leave_data
steps.description: Validate fields and compute needsActivation / needsReset flags against today's date.

steps.name: notify_hr_channel
steps.description: Post leave-activated message to HR Slack channel. Runs for each record where needsActivation=True.

steps.name: send_ooo_reminder_email
steps.description: Email the employee to update their Slack status to Out of Office.

steps.name: mark_leave_as_active
steps.description: Update leave record status to Active to prevent duplicate activations.

steps.name: notify_hr_leave_reset
steps.description: Post leave-completed message to HR Slack channel. Runs for each record where needsReset=True.
